info.tactics: Pioneers are support units that enhance their allies' mobility while hindering that of enemies. Unlike their Mirage colleagues, they support from the frontline, focusing their efforts on a specific area of the battlefield and providing benefits both on their own turn and on allied turns. Pioneers are durable and have few weaknesses, but cannot accomplish much on their own.
info.terse: Frontline support that enhances allies' mobility and hinders that of enemies.

deployables.name: Pavement Drone
deployables.detail:
This drone can be attached to a free space or vertical surface within Range 5, where it covers a Burst 3 area with whitewash pavement. The pavement affects characters that are at least partially within the Burst 3 area and not flying. While on the pavement, the Pioneer and allied characters gain Immunity to the effects of Slowed, and whenever they begin movement on the pavement or move onto it, they gain +2 Speed until the end of the turn. Hostile characters that start their turn on the pavement or move onto for the first time in a round must pass an Engineering save or become Slowed until the start of their next turn.
The Pioneer can deploy only one Pavement Drone at a time, but may redeploy an existing drone by taking this action again. The pavement lasts until the drone is redeployed or destroyed.

actions.name: Reconnoiter
actions.detail: Survey the battlefield, enabling up to two allied characters within Sensors to Boost as a reaction.

name: All-Terrain Treads
effect: The Pioneer ignores difficult terrain. When it makes an Engineering check against dangerous terrain or Burn, it may take 2 Heat to automatically succeed.

active_effects.name: All-Terrain Treads
active_effects.detail: You ignore difficult terrain. When you make an Engineering check against dangerous terrain or Burn, you may take 2 Heat to automatically succeed.

name: Expansionist
effect: The Pioneer may have up to two Pavement Drones deployed at a time, but each drone only affects a Burst 2 area. As a protocol, the Pioneer can move all Pavement Drones up to 3 spaces in any direction.

actions.name: Move Pavement Drones
actions.detail: Move all Pavement Drones up to 3 spaces in any direction.

name: Sensor Relays
effect: When the Pioneer or an allied character uses a non-attack action or reaction, they may draw line of sight and measure distance starting from any Pavement Drone instead of themselves.

active_effects.name: Sensor Relays
active_effects.condition: You or an allied character use a non-attack action or reaction.
active_effects.detail: The triggering character may draw line of sight and measure distance starting from any Pavement Drone instead of themselves.

actions.name: Map-Territory Misalignment
actions.detail: A hostile character within Sensors must pass a Systems save with +1 Difficulty or choose one: they only have line of sight within Range 3 until the end of their next turn, or they immediately move up to 4 spaces in a direction of your choice. This movement ignores engagement and does not provoke reactions.

add_special.detail: You only have line of sight within Range 3.

name: Displacement Mine
effect: The Pioneer deploys a displacement mine in a free space within Range 3. The mine detonates in a Burst 1 area when an adjacent allied character triggers it as a free action or when a hostile character moves adjacent. Characters in the area are pushed 4 spaces in a direction of the Pioneer's choice, and hostile characters must additionally pass an Agility save or be knocked Prone. The Pioneer regains a charge of this system whenever a mine detonates.

deployables.name: Displacement Mine
deployables.detail: Characters in the area are pushed 4 spaces in a direction of the Pioneer's choice, and hostile characters must additionally pass an Agility save or be knocked Prone.

actions.name: Manifest Destiny
actions.detail:
Convert your intel into a decisive advantage. While this system is active, no other copy of it can be activated, and the following effects apply:
  • You take 4 Heat at the end of each round before all other end-of-round effects.
  • While you are adjacent to an Objective or in a Control Zone, hostile characters cannot Interact with, contest, or score that Objective or Control Zone.
This system remains active until you deactivate it as a protocol, become Jammed, Exposed, or Stunned, break adjacency with an Objective, or leave a Control Zone.

active_effects.name: Manifest Destiny
active_effects.detail: Take 4 Heat at the end of each round before all other end-of-round effects. While you are adjacent to an Objective or in a Control Zone, hostile characters cannot Interact with, contest, or score that Objective or Control Zone.

name: Breakfall Routines [Veteran]
effect: While affected by a Pavement Drone, the Pioneer and allied characters may stand up from Prone as a free action, climb at normal speed, and always ignore difficult terrain and dangerous terrain.
